body.div:
Default implementation of the CollectionFinder interface. The standard CollectionFinder recognizes four types of collection:
Any URI may be explicitly registered and associated with an instance of net.sf.saxon.lib.ResourceCollection
If the file: URI scheme is used, and the relevant file identifies a directory, the directory is treated as a collection: it is returned as an instance of net.sf.saxon.resource.DirectoryCollection
If the URI ends with ".jar" or ".zip", or more generally, if the method #isJarFileURI(String) returns true, the URI is treated as identifying a JAR or ZIP archive, whose contents form the resources in the collection: it is returned as an instance of net.sf.saxon.resource.JarCollection
In all other cases, the URI is treated as the URI of an XML document listing the URIs of the resources in the collection, which are then retrieved using the javax.xml.transform.URIResolver
